hook.name: RigHook
hook.description: Proof-of-liquidity mining hook for a single ETH/RIG pool. Applies buy (2%) and sell (5%) swap taxes via BeforeSwapDelta; buy tax funds ETH rewards, sell tax is 50% burned and 50% swapped back to ETH via an internal poolManager.swap() call. Rewards are distributed per 720-second epoch to LPs weighted by capital depth, range tightness, and position age.
